description: Catalogued mutants (QA-02 step 5, tools/mutants.mjs). Each entry is one deliberate defect in a guard: `find` is text of the compiled module dist/<file>.js (whitespace runs match any whitespace) that must occur exactly once, `replace` is the defect, `tests` are the tests named to kill it. Release qualification requires every mutant killed. Add a mutant with the test that kills it; never delete one whose guard still exists.

mutants.guards: Google Ads requests carry the account's own manager (login-customer-id), not the login's default manager
SEC-04: every OWASP formula prefix (= + - @, tab, CR, LF) is neutralized in CSV and Sheets cells
SEC-04: full-width formula triggers, which spreadsheets normalize to ASCII, are neutralized
A website upload is unavailable exactly at its 30-minute deadline, not one millisecond later
Reach and frequency are never summed across days in detailed Overview rows
EXP-02 / D13: a nonexistent local time shifts forward to the first valid time instead of skipping the occurrence
A repeated (fall-back) local hour runs a schedule once, not twice
mutants.find: if (at > after && format.format(at) !== previous) candidates.push({ at, shifted: false });
mutants.replace: if (at > after) candidates.push({ at, shifted: false });

mutants.guards: A provider change between review and execute is refused as STATE_CHANGED before anything is sent
A review's TikTok list snapshot keeps the decisive budget field, so a budget change is STATE_CHANGED
mutants.replace: : { list: d.data.list.map(row => { const { budget, ...rest } = row ?? {}; return rest; }) },

mutants.guards: A TikTok saved-audience deletion naming an ID twice is refused before any request
An idempotency key already used for a different request is refused (IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT)
A pending or uncertain write is never sent again by a later execute
mutants.find: throw new MirrorError('WRITE_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN', 'This key is pending or has an uncertain outcome.
mutants.replace: return { fresh: true }; throw new MirrorError('WRITE_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN', 'This key is pending or has an uncertain outcome.

mutants.guards: D12: only a pending claim raised before any request is released; a completed or uncertain one never is
mutants.find: DELETE FROM idempotency WHERE tenant_id=? AND key=? AND state='pending' AND fingerprint=?
mutants.replace: DELETE FROM idempotency WHERE tenant_id=? AND key=? AND fingerprint=?

mutants.guards: A state read the provider answers with another page is refused (INCOMPLETE_STATE), never reviewed as complete
The owner's daily increase cap counts the increase being executed, not only earlier ones
The owner's maximum budget increase percentage refuses a larger increase
The owner's maximum bid refuses a higher bid
CON-01: AMCP’s own refresh of the same login keeps its login stamp, so an export or review continues
mutants.find: return ref && authorityFence() === 'revision' ? revisionStamp(ref, credentials) : 'credentials:' + sha256(stable(credentials));

mutants.guards: A replaced login changes the login stamp and stops an export before it writes
mutants.find: return ref && authorityFence() === 'revision' ? revisionStamp(ref, credentials) : 'credentials:' + sha256(stable(credentials));

mutants.guards: TikTok cursor lists ({cursor, has_more}) are followed to their last page instead of being cut at the first
Meta paging.next with cursors.after is followed instead of truncating the collection
mutants.find: if (!d.paging?.next) return null; const cursor = d.paging?.cursors?.after;

mutants.guards: RPT-02: a detailed source whose window is not declared complete stays partial
RPT-01 / D10: provider doubles in exponent form (1e-7) are read exactly, not refused
D10: provider values beyond nine places round half to even, not half up
A provider value in a native unit (micros) is scaled by its divisor before rounding
PRV-03: Microsoft AddAds and UpdateAds are verified by a GetAdsByIds read that names AdTypes
EXP-01 / D11: an unconfirmed Sheets batch is never resent inside its 10-minute settle window
EXP-01 liveness: after the settle window the identical batch is resent once and the tab is released
EXP-03: an older snapshot never replaces a newer one in a tab; it is reported superseded
An owner's pause of reviewed writes refuses every execute before anything is sent
mutants.find: const pause = writePause(store, tenant); if (pause && pauseCovers(pause, effect))

mutants.guards: WRT-04: a second execute of one target waits for the first (bounded) instead of failing busy at once
PRV-05: with AMCP_WIRE_CONTRACTS=enforce a write whose body differs from its pinned contract is refused
A queued scheduled export stops when its schedule is paused, edited or removed
